sources.title: Veo 3 — Google's Native-Audio Video Model · AI Evolution Tree
sources.snippet: Google's third-generation text-to-video model, released May 2025 and integrated into Gemini and Google Vertex AI by summer. Headline capability: native synchronized audio generation (speech, music, sound effects) at the same time as the video — beating Sora 2 (which added native audio in September 2025) to that capability by 4 months.
